observations: Actual diff read: document migrations require mutually exclusive section scope, current source heading ID/text, all historic/native anchors mapped to the same stable section, and source/target/dependency hash triples matching current independently reviewed inputs. loadHeadingMigrations forces complete source checks even in preview mode; the WeakSet prevents passing an unchecked migration array.

Actual HTML check read: historic alias, native heading and canonical semantic anchor must each be unique and resolve to the same DOM heading. The previous historic module is preserved even when undefined for native Starlight content. Wrong task, detached alias, different module and duplicate IDs remain rejection cases.

Home module migrations preserve exact registered localized destinations. The new external case accepts canonical HTTPS without credentials and requires that exact URL inside the same unique historic module. The next-module guard still requires both local JSON and comparison destinations; allowing external performance evidence does not replace that guard.

Read added negative tests for changed source heading, missing source heading, semantic mapping mismatch, illegal home section scope, mixed scopes, alias detachment, wrong native ID, duplicate anchors, module relocation, missing/moved external evidence and HTTP/credentialed URL rejection.

Twelve configured wording changes are the already reviewed editorial corrections: five document/article sections plus seven home modules. No new product text, task, SDK behavior, destination or benchmark claim is introduced by this checker/config delta.
